skill.name: business-conflict-analyzer
skill.description: Analyzes API, schema, configuration, message, and UI contract changes to identify business impact, affected consumers, and migration needs.
skill.summary: Find breaking change impact before code is committed.
skill.author: gobeyondyang

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code spans, Mermaid samples, unit-test fixtures, and fixed git or grep argument lists. Confirmed risks remain around unpinned remote script fetches, persistent commit-hook installation, parent-directory frontend scanning, destructive rollback guidance, and broad autonomous code modification instructions.

remediation.suggestion: Pin fetch URLs to immutable commits or package the helper files directly with integrity verification.
Require explicit confirmation, show the exact settings diff, document uninstall steps, and avoid automatic hook installation.
Replace git checkout -- . guidance with a reviewed file list, patch reversal, or stash-based recovery plan.
Require a proposed file list and user confirmation before editing each impacted consumer area.

remediation.issue: Frontend scan can leave the project root
remediation.suggestion: Restrict scans to the repository by default and require explicit confirmation for parent, sibling, or absolute frontend roots.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Remote Script Fetches
semantic_findings.description: The skill fetches executable helper scripts from GitHub raw URLs on the main branch. Mutable remote script loading can change behavior after marketplace review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fetch frontmatter explicitly lists raw GitHub URLs for Python and shell helper files, and the prose says they download automatically. I found no hash or immutable commit pin in those lines.

semantic_findings.title: Persistent Commit Hook Installation
semantic_findings.description: The optional installer writes a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that intercepts git commit and runs the guard script. This persists behavior in a hidden project configuration file.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill instructions and installer both state that a PreToolUse hook is added for git commit, and the script writes that hook into settings.local.json.

semantic_findings.title: Destructive Rollback Command Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The post-guard decision table tells the assistant to run git checkout -- . when a user rejects a change. That can discard unrelated working tree changes without per-file review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exact rollback command appears in the reject path, and the next line says the assistant should autonomously execute actions after the user chooses an option.

semantic_findings.title: Overbroad Autonomous Code Modification Scope
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the assistant to automatically fix all impacted consumer sites and not ask per consumer. This can authorize broad edits beyond the original requested files.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions repeatedly say the assistant must fix all impacted consumers automatically, including a statement not to ask the user per consumer.

content.value_statement: Code changes can break consumers before teams notice. This skill reviews diffs, maps impacted services, and prepares business-readable recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Parses git diffs for Java, Python, TypeScript, Go, Vue, React, Kotlin, JSP, SQL, YAML, and XML changes.
Classifies contract changes by P0, P1, and P2 business impact levels.
Searches project references and common frontend roots for affected consumers.
Generates English or Chinese impact reports with business language and Mermaid graphs.
Can install an optional Claude Code commit guard that blocks detected P0 changes.
Maps common patterns for DTO fields, DDL, API routes, messages, configs, enums, and component props.
limitations: Requires Python 3.8 and a git repository for the automated pipeline.
Static symbol matching can miss dynamic imports, reflection, generated clients, and runtime configuration.
Large monorepos may need explicit scan limits for acceptable performance.
The optional commit guard changes local Claude settings and should be installed carefully.

use_cases.title: Review API Changes
use_cases.description: Find services, pages, and clients affected by changed request fields, response fields, or route paths.

use_cases.title: Plan Database Changes
use_cases.description: Identify migration needs and release risks before columns, tables, or schema contracts change.

use_cases.title: Guard Release Commits
use_cases.description: Use the optional commit guard to stop high-impact changes until a human decision is made.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Current Diff
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check before opening a pull request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my current git diff for business impact. Summarize affected users, services, data, and recommended next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Field Rename
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this field rename for backward compatibility. Identify consumers, migration steps, and a safe release sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Check Schema Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this database schema change. Explain data migration needs, rollback concerns, consumer impact, and required approvals.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Multi-Service Contract Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Map this contract change across backend, frontend, message, config, and test consumers. Produce a decision-ready impact report.

output_examples.input: A user profile field is removed and replaced with a new phone field.
output: High risk: existing consumers may fail when the old field disappears.
Affected areas: profile pages, order exports, payment integrations, and serialized user data.
Recommendation: keep both fields for one release and migrate consumers before removal.

output_examples.input: An order endpoint path changes from version one to version two.
output: High risk: clients using the old route may receive not found errors.
Affected areas: frontend calls, partner integrations, API tests, and gateway routing.
Recommendation: publish the new route while retaining the old route during migration.

output_examples.input: A configuration key is deleted from an application settings file.
output: Medium risk: services may fall back to defaults or fail at startup.
Affected areas: deployment configuration, runtime behavior, and monitoring alerts.
Recommendation: verify defaults and remove code bindings before deleting the key.

best_practices: Run the analysis before committing changes that alter external contracts.
Review the impacted file list before accepting automated fixes.
Pin or vendor fetched helper scripts before using this in sensitive repositories.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the report as a substitute for tests, owners, or release approvals.
Do not install the commit guard without reviewing the settings change.
Do not use repository-wide rollback commands when unrelated local work exists.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes code diffs for contract, schema, configuration, message, and UI changes that may affect consumers.

faq.question: Does it change code automatically?
faq.answer: The analysis pipeline reports impact. Some skill instructions propose auto-fixes after approval, so review changes before applying them.

faq.question: Does the commit guard install by default?
faq.answer: No. The guard is optional, but installing it modifies project Claude settings to run a pre-command hook.

faq.question: Can it work outside Java projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes parsers for Python, TypeScript, Go, Vue, React, Kotlin, JSP, SQL, YAML, XML, and configuration files.

faq.question: What languages can reports use?
faq.answer: Reports can use English or Chinese, based on explicit settings or local language environment variables.

faq.question: What should teams review before publishing this skill?
faq.answer: Review remote fetch pinning, hook installation behavior, frontend scan scope, broad auto-fix instructions, and rollback guidance.
